title: Guard Your Mouth, Worship, and Walk in Love (Luke 17:11-19) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse reads four passages: the ten lepers, the Canaanite woman, Mary and Martha, and Mary anointing Jesus. He draws a simple contrast between those who worshiped and gave thanks and those who complained. He teaches that guarding your mouth and what you listen to keeps your faith working, and that walking in love and thanking God keep the door open for healing. He shares a testimony of a young woman who wrote out healing scriptures and saw her skin healed. He closes by praying for the sick and leading listeners in a prayer to receive Jesus.
topic: Guard Your Mouth, Worship, and Walk in Love

title: Take Authority Over Problems in Jesus' Name (Matthew 18:18) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse walks through the Gospels to show how Jesus took authority over problems by speaking, and how believers can do the same. He reads on binding and loosing, speaking to the mountain, and how Jesus answered the devil with "it is written." He shares personal stories of facing fear and speaking the Word instead of simply wondering and worrying. He also encourages believers to ask the Holy Spirit for guidance and to keep praying in the spirit. The message closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and a prayer for the listeners.
topic: Take Authority Over Problems in Jesus' Name

title: Mark 11:24: Believe, Receive, Claim Your Inheritance | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse teaches from Mark 11:23-24 and Matthew 21:22. He explains that Jesus said "all things" you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive, and that this promise has no disclaimer. He shares what happened when he first told people about these verses after he was born again. He reminds believers that God loves them and is not angry with them, and that everything the Father has belongs to them as heirs. He points to Bartimaeus, who kept crying out until Jesus answered him, and encourages listeners to stay bold with God's Word. The service closes with a prayer to receive Jesus as Lord and a prayer for everyone watching.
topic: Mark 11:24: Believe, Receive, Claim Your Inheritance

title: Use Your Authority: Speak to the Mountain (Mark 11:23) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse walks through Matthew, Mark and Luke to show how Jesus taught believers to use their authority by speaking to the mountain. He ties it to Proverbs 4, where God tells us to keep His words before our eyes so they can be life and health to us. Jesse shares how he learned to take authority in Jesus' name, from praying over his workdays to a ballroom contract problem that was solved after a week of prayer. He encourages everyone to read the New Testament every day, so the Word is in them when trouble comes. The service closes with Romans 10:9 and a prayer to receive Jesus as Lord.
topic: Use Your Authority: Speak to the Mountain

title: Feed on the Word and Speak to Your Mountain (3 John 2) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse opens in 3 John 2 and shows that God's desire for His children is that they prosper and be in health. He explains that believers claim this inheritance by finding out what the new covenant says and decreeing it with their mouths. He shares how he keeps his spirit strong by reading the New Testament for an hour at a time, and why a weak result often means the Word level is too low. He teaches from Mark 11:23 that Jesus said to speak to the mountain, not just talk about it or depend on other people's prayers. He closes by leading listeners in a prayer to receive Jesus as Lord from Romans 10.
topic: Feed on the Word and Speak to Your Mountain

title: Prosper and Be in Health: Speak to It (3 John 2) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse Rich opens in 3 John 2 and shows that God wishes you to prosper and be in health. He explains that believers don't have to "suffer for Jesus", because Jesus already suffered for them. He urges listeners to fill their hearts with the Word by reading the New Testament every day and hearing it out loud. He walks through Mark 11:23 and asks whether you have actually spoken to the mountain in Jesus' name. He closes with a message on keeping a clear conscience before God, and an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord.
topic: Prosper and Be in Health: Speak to It

title: Praying in Tongues: Build Up Your Spirit Man (Acts 2:4) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse walks through Acts, Romans 8, Jude and 1 Corinthians 14 to show why the baptism of the Holy Spirit and praying in tongues matter for every believer. He explains that tongues edifies and builds up your most holy faith. He also teaches that tongues helps you pray the will of God when you don't know how to pray. He shares how he prayed in tongues through a hotel problem, a search for an apartment in New York City, and a lost passport and visa. The message ends with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and be filled with the Holy Spirit.
topic: Praying in Tongues: Build Up Your Spirit Man

title: Attend to God's Word and Speak It (Proverbs 4:20-22) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse teaches from Proverbs that God's words are life and health to all our flesh, and he shows how to put the Word first when anything comes up in your life. He shares how he was sick and in the hospital as a young man, and how learning that death and life are in the power of the tongue changed how he speaks. He walks through Jesus' words in Matthew and Mark about speaking to the mountain, and he encourages believers to hold fast to their confession of faith when pressure comes. He also talks about being built up through reading the Word and praying in the Holy Spirit. The service closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord.
topic: Attend to God's Word and Speak It

title: Claim Your Hundredfold Return in Jesus (Mark 10:29-30) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse opens in Mark 10 and shows that Jesus promised a hundredfold return to those who give up something for Him and the Gospel. He walks through Malachi 3, 2 Corinthians 9 and Luke 6:38, and teaches believers to thank God daily and speak the Word over their lives. He shares how he used Psalm 30:6 and 3 John 2 to rebuke doubt when he was struggling. He encourages listeners to keep reading scripture in any area where their faith feels weak, so their spirit is built up. The service closes with a prayer to receive Jesus as Lord and information about the upcoming New England Thanksgiving Bible meetings.
topic: Claim Your Hundredfold Return in Jesus

title: Feed Your Faith Daily on Healing Scriptures (Romans 10:17) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse teaches why every believer needs to feed on God's Word daily, especially healing scriptures, starting from Romans 10:17 and Proverbs 4:20-22, which he compares to the directions on a prescription. He walks through Luke 13 and 1 Peter 5 to show that believers have an enemy and need to resist with the Word spoken aloud. He shares the story of reading his healing confessions on a porch swing and answering a friend with 'do not let the word depart from your eyes.' He also recalls losing his health at 18 and urges listeners to hold on to 1 Peter 2:24 and keep their mouths speaking God's Word. The service closes with a prayer to receive Jesus as Lord.
topic: Feed Your Faith Daily on Healing Scriptures

title: Feed Your Faith With Healing Scriptures (Matthew 4:4) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse teaches from Matthew 4:4 that believers must feed their faith on God's Word every day, especially when believing God for healing. He walks through Proverbs 4:20-22 and compares Scripture to the label on a prescription, with instructions to follow. He explains from Matthew 7 that the person who hears and acts on the Word stands through the storm. He also shares why healing comes by faith, like salvation, and tells of a time he lay paralyzed in a hospital. The message closes with a prayer for healing and an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord.
topic: Feed Your Faith With Healing Scriptures

chapters.label: God's Word Is Like a Prescription

title: Tuesday Service 11/3/26: Decree and Declare Your Covenant of Prosperity
desc: Pastor Jesse opens in 3 John 2 and shows from John 10:10, Mark 10:29-30, Psalm 35:27 and 2 Corinthians 8:9 that God's will includes provision and health for His children. He explains how he took 3 John 2 as his own verse and began speaking it daily, with worship and thanksgiving. From Psalm 103 he teaches that angels respond to God's Word spoken in faith. He encourages listeners to feed their faith with scripture, take authority over lack and sickness right away, and keep praising God. The message closes with Romans 10 and a prayer for anyone who wants to receive Jesus as Lord.
topic: Decree and Declare Your Covenant of Prosperity

title: Sunday Service 11/1/26: Feed Your Faith: Stay Built Up on God's Word
desc: Pastor Jesse teaches that faith is fed by continually hearing God's word, and that we should never assume we've already heard it. He shows how to back up every prayer for healing or finances with scripture, so you know you are praying God's will. Using John 15, Matthew 18:19, and James 1, he explains how to stand your ground after you pray, thank God instead of asking again, and answer doubt with the word. He encourages a daily habit of reading and studying, with a healing devotional as a practical tool, and closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and a prayer for those watching. Scriptures: Romans 10:17, John 15:7, Matthew 18:19, James 1:5-8.
topic: Feed Your Faith: Stay Built Up on God's Word

chapters.label: Standing on Your Prayer of Agreement
Being a Doer of the Word

title: Tuesday Service 10/20/26: Stay Thankful: Remember What God Has Done
desc: Pastor Jesse continues the Gospel of John series in chapter 6 and shows what Jesus did when He faced a need: He gave thanks before the miracle came. He pairs it with Matthew 16, where the disciples forgot what God had just done and fell into worry. Pastor Jesse encourages believers to stop and remember what God has done for them, from healing to deliverance, and to turn their worries into thanksgiving. He shares stories of pastors who stayed grateful and generous and saw God take care of them. The message closes with a clear invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and Savior. Scriptures: John 6:5-13, Matthew 16:7-10, Romans 10:9-10, 1 Thessalonians 5:18.
topic: Stay Thankful: Remember What God Has Done

title: Tuesday Service 10/13/26: Use Your Authority: Speak to Your Mountain
desc: Pastor Jesse opens in Matthew 18:18 and Philippians 2 to show that believers have been given the name of Jesus and real authority over the devil. He teaches that we are to speak to our problems, not just talk to God about them, and to keep standing on our confession of faith as Jesus did in Matthew 17:20. He shows from James 2 that faith has to be put to work, and he points to Caleb as an example of speaking boldly about the mountain instead of complaining about it. He then warns about the cost of judging others and talking against ministers, and shares a personal story of choosing to give and pray instead. The message closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and a prayer of salvation.
topic: Use Your Authority: Speak to Your Mountain

title: Sunday Service 10/11/26: Follow the Spirit Within and Obey God Now
desc: Pastor Rich opens with Jesus in Gethsemane and Romans 8:14, then moves to the parable of the rich fool in Luke 12. He shows how the man planned only for his own comfort and never sought God. Pastor Rich teaches that believers are meant to be led by the Spirit and to obey the inward witness right away, whether that means giving, serving, or following a call. He shares stories from his own life, including his early years in church and a newspaper route he almost quit, to show why we should stay hungry for God. The message closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and Savior. Scriptures: Luke 12:16-21, Luke 4:1, Ecclesiastes 11:1-4, Romans 8:14.
topic: Follow the Spirit Within and Obey God Now

title: Tuesday Service 10/6/26: Take Authority Over Satan: Hold Fast Your Confession
desc: Pastor Jesse walks through the key scriptures on binding and loosing, including Matthew 12, 16 and 18, Mark 16, Luke 10 and Philippians 2, to show how believers can exercise the authority Jesus gave them. He shares how he used those verses on his job and finances during a hard season, and how he speaks to pain in Jesus' name until it leaves. From 1 Timothy 4, he explains why it matters to hold fast your confession of faith and not be talked out of it by seducing spirits. He also encourages speaking strength over your body, staying thankful with a spirit of victory, and making your mouth work for you in praise. The service closes with a prayer to receive Jesus as Lord. Scriptures: Matthew 18:18, Mark 16:17-18, Luke 13:16, 1 Timothy 4:1.
topic: Take Authority Over Satan: Hold Fast Your Confession

title: Sunday Service 10/4/26: Speak to Your Mountain: Mark 11:23 Faith
desc: Pastor Jesse teaches from Mark 11:23 that Jesus told us to speak to our mountains, not only pray about them. He connects James 3 and the power of the tongue, showing why we should watch our words and also command sickness, fear and lack to go in Jesus' name. He shares his own testimony of attending church without ever confessing Jesus as Lord, then walks through Romans 10:9-10 on salvation by confession. He encourages believers to give and receive in faith, to keep thanking God, and to hold onto childlike faith. The message closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and a prayer.
topic: Speak to Your Mountain: Mark 11:23 Faith
